[[File:Doornik-1142.png|thumb|250px|[[Doornik-1142/Legends|Doornik-1142]], a [[Color/Legends|brown]] dwarf]]
A '''brown dwarf''' was a [[Star/Legends|star]] whose mass was too small to maintain [[Hydrogen/Legends|hydrogen]] fusion reactions. [[Doornik-1142/Legends|Doornik-1142]]<ref name="BtS">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref> and [[Goroth Beta]] were brown dwarfs.<ref name="Goroth">''[[Goroth: Slave of the Empire]]''</ref>
